tokoh_utama: A 17-year-old Indonesian teenage boy with short black hair, wearing a casual dark grey t-shirt and shorts

part.pertanyaan: Di rumah kalian ada aturan aneh dari orang tua juga? Cerita di komen.
part.caption: Jangan pernah langsung samperin kalau dipanggil dari dapur... Aturan rumah ini bikin merinding!

adegan.narasi: Ibuku punya satu aturan aneh sejak aku kecil saat di rumah.
adegan.gambar: Interior of a modest Indonesian living room at night, warm dim lighting, cozy atmosphere with a wooden coffee table.

adegan.narasi: Ibu berkata, "Kalau Ibu panggil dari dapur, wajib jawab dulu dari kamar, ya."
adegan.gambar: An Indonesian mother in her 40s wearing a simple batik duster dress, sitting on a sofa talking to her son.

adegan.narasi: Ibu bilang, "Kalau beneran Ibu, Ibu pasti bakal jawab balik padamu."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the mother's face with a serious expression, looking directly at the young boy.

adegan.narasi: Aku selalu menganggap larangan itu cuma bercandaan lama untuk menakut-nakuti saja.
adegan.gambar: The 17-year-old Indonesian boy smiling and shaking his head dismissively sitting in the living room.

adegan.narasi: Malam Minggu itu, koper merah Ibu sudah rapi tergeletak dekat TV.
adegan.gambar: A bright red packed travel suitcase standing next to an old television cabinet in the living room.

adegan.narasi: Ibu siap berangkat dinas luar kota besok pagi-pagi sekali dengan travel.
adegan.gambar: The mother checking her travel document on the table while sitting beside her son.

adegan.narasi: Kami berdua santai nonton acara TV sambil menikmati camilan malam hangat.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of mother and son sitting together on the couch watching the glowing TV screen in the dark room.

adegan.narasi: Suasana sangat tenang, kipas angin tua di sudut ruang berputar pelan.
adegan.gambar: An old standing electric fan oscillating slowly in the corner of the dimly lit living room.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba notifikasi ponselku bergetar keras di atas meja kayu ruang tengah.
adegan.gambar: A smartphone resting on the wooden coffee table lighting up with a bright screen vibration.

adegan.narasi: Suasana berubah merinding saat angin dingin terasa berhembus dari arah dapur.
adegan.gambar: Living room view looking towards the dark kitchen doorway in the background. A pale, bony hand with long fingers is gripping the kitchen wooden doorframe sinisterly.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba dari dapur gelap terdengar suara yang sangat akrab memanggil namaku.
adegan.gambar: The pitch-black opening of the kitchen doorway, eerie dim shadows looming inside.

adegan.narasi: Suara itu persis suara Ibu, "Nak, sini bantuin Ibu di dapur sebentar."
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up on the teenage boy's shocked face staring wide-eyed toward the dark kitchen.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau kamu jadi aku, kamu bakal menoleh ke dapur nggak?
part.caption: Suara Ibu memanggil dari dapur, tapi Ibu asli ada di sebelahku... Siapa di sana?

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan. Aku kaget karena Ibu padahal sedang duduk tepat di sebelahku.
adegan.gambar: The teenage boy turning his head rapidly to look at his mother sitting right next to him on the sofa.

adegan.narasi: Ibu mendadak memegang tanganku sangat kuat sampai jariku terasa begitu sakit.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the mother's hand tightly gripping her son's arm, knuckles turning white.

adegan.narasi: Ibu menatapku lurus dengan wajah pucat lalu berbisik, "Jawab dari sini."
adegan.gambar: The mother looking terrified, pale face, whispering closely to her son's ear.

adegan.narasi: Jantungku berdebar kencang, aku memberanikan diri berteriak, "Iya Bu, sebentar lagi."
adegan.gambar: The boy sweating, mouth open shouting nervously toward the hallway while trembling.

adegan.narasi: Sesaat setelah suara sahutanku, gema panggilan dari arah dapur langsung terhenti.
adegan.gambar: Dead silence in the living room, shadows stretching long across the floor from the doorway.

adegan.narasi: Keheningan mencekam menyelimuti ruang tengah, bahkan suara kipas angin serasa lenyap.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of the dimly lit room, frozen in absolute tension as both look towards the hallway.

adegan.narasi: Lampu gantung di atas kami mendadak berkedip-kedip redup beberapa kali berturut-turut.
adegan.gambar: Low angle view of a single ceiling light bulb flickering erratic yellowish light in the darkness.

adegan.narasi: Dari dalam lorong dapur gelap, terdengar bunyi langkah kaki perlahan mendekat.
adegan.gambar: Dark hallway floor leading from the kitchen, heavy shadowy footsteps coming forward.

adegan.narasi: Pantulan layar TV mati memperlihatkan kegelapan ruangan yang sangat menegangkan malam itu.
adegan.gambar: A reflection in the black glass screen of the turned-off TV: behind the boy and mother, a tall distorted shadowy silhouette with an inhumanly long neck is visible standing silently.

adegan.narasi: Langkah kaki itu makin dekat, melangkah berat menyeret sandal rumah milik Ibu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of human-like pale feet wearing rubber house slippers dragging slowly on the floor tiles.

adegan.narasi: Sosok itu perlahan berdiri tepat di ambang pintu dapur yang gelap gulita.
adegan.gambar: A tall humanoid creature emerging partially from the kitchen doorway dark entrance.

adegan.narasi: Wajahnya mirip Ibu tapi bentuknya terlalu panjang ganjil dan tersenyum lebar.
adegan.gambar: Terrifying close-up of a creature wearing the mother's face, but with abnormally stretched long jaw, wide uncanny staring eyes, and an unnaturally wide, malicious grin.

part.pertanyaan: Menurut kalian, apa sebenarnya yang ada di dalam kamar Ibu?
part.caption: Ibu sudah pergi ke luar kota... tapi kenapa suaranya ada di dalam kamar?

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan. Ibu langsung menepuk pundakku dan berbisik, "Baca doa, jangan menoleh."
adegan.gambar: Mother covering her son's eyes with her trembling hands, whispering intensely in his ear.

adegan.narasi: Aku memejamkan mata rapat-rapat sambil merapalkan doa dengan badan gemetaran hebat.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the boy squeezing his eyes shut tight, lips moving rapidly in desperate prayer.

adegan.narasi: Langkah sosok ganjil itu perlahan menjauh kembali menembus kegelapan lorong dapur.
adegan.gambar: The creepy long silhouette receding back into the dark kitchen doorway, fading into shadows.

adegan.narasi: Suasana akhirnya kembali hening sampai fajar menyingsing membiaskan cahaya pagi terang.
adegan.gambar: Morning sunlight streaming brightly through the living room window, illuminating the safe clean house.

adegan.narasi: Pagi harinya saat sarapan, Ibu menceritakan kisah lama keluarga kami padaku.
adegan.gambar: The boy and his mother sitting at the kitchen table in daylight with tea cups, talking calmly.

adegan.narasi: Dulu nenek juga punya aturan ketat yang sama persis di rumahnya.
adegan.gambar: An old framed black and white photograph of an elderly Indonesian grandmother on the wall.

adegan.narasi: "Ada hal lain yang suka meniru suara kita," kata Ibu menenangkan.
adegan.gambar: Mother smiling softly, patting her son's hand over the dining table warmly.

adegan.narasi: Aku merasa lega mendengarnya dan mengantar Ibu naik travel luar kota.
adegan.gambar: The boy waving goodbye to a travel van leaving down the suburban street outside his house.

adegan.narasi: Malam harinya aku sendirian di rumah, suasana sunyi menyelimuti seluruh ruangan.
adegan.gambar: The teenage boy sitting alone on the living room couch at night, holding his smartphone in silence.

adegan.narasi: Saat aku lewat depan kamar Ibu yang terkunci, bulu kudukku mendadak berdiri.
adegan.gambar: The boy walking down the dark hallway past his mother's locked bedroom door, freezing in place.

adegan.narasi: Celah bawah pintu kamar Ibu yang gelap memperlihatkan bayangan berdiri diam.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the gap under the locked wooden bedroom door. Through the dark crack, two pale long gray toes and an unnatural glowing eye are visible pressed flat against the floor.

adegan.narasi: Dari dalam kamar kosong itu terdengar suara Ibu, "Nak, kok nggak jawab dulu?"
adegan.gambar: Close-up shot of the locked door brass handle slowly turning by itself from inside the pitch-black bedroom.
